"""Task-owned scoped DNS/NAT trace; no combined source-runtime acceptance."""
import argparse,hashlib,ipaddress,json,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'outputs'/'GoldenHoop'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tests'))
from destination_contract import DestinationComponentContract
from dns_samples import DNS
from network_contract import docker

class Diagnostic(DestinationComponentContract):
    def kernel_policy_cases(self):
        self.evidence['scope']='focused actual DNS infrastructure and scoped nft trace only; omits parent packet/source contracts'
        code=Path(__file__).read_bytes();self.evidence['diagnostic_script']={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest(),'text':code.decode()}
        self.prepare_protected_target()
        network=next(r['network_id'] for r in self.evidence['resources'] if r['role']=='target-net')
        server=self.container('dns-target',['--runtime','runc','--network',network,'--user','1000:1000','--memory','128m','--memory-swap','128m','--cpus','0.25','--pids-limit','32','--publish','127.0.0.1::19004/udp','--publish','127.0.0.1::19004/tcp'],DNS,self.target_ip)
        self.ready(server);info=json.loads(docker('inspect',server).stdout)[0]
        endpoint=next(iter(info['NetworkSettings']['Networks'].values()))['IPAddress']+':19004'
        self.rpc('quarantine',expected_revision=self.revision)
        self.rpc('enable_dns',expected_revision=self.revision,upstream=endpoint,remaining_seconds=120)
        config={'policies':[{'default_action':'allow','rules':[]}]}
        self.apply_config(config)
        self.dns_probe(self.guest,'udp',self.gateway,53,'long.test',0)
        self.check('focused_dns_gateway_redirect_is_live_before_destination_floor')
        self.rpc('quarantine',expected_revision=self.revision)
        target=next(r for r in self.evidence['resources'] if r['role']=='target-net')
        observed=self.rpc('protect_destinations',expected_revision=self.revision,private_exceptions=[str(ipaddress.ip_network(c['Subnet'])) for c in target['ipam']['Config']],control_addresses=[])['result']
        self.protected_bound=True;self.destination_digest=observed['destination_binding_sha256']
        self.apply_config(config)
        table='gh_t_'+self.attempt
        assert not any(e.get('table',{}).get('name')==table for e in self.tables())
        self.translation_attempted=True
        self.exec(self.helper,'nft','--file','-',data=f'add table inet {table}\nadd chain inet {table} {self.owner.replace(":","_")}\nadd chain inet {table} trace {{ type filter hook prerouting priority -301; policy accept; }}\nadd rule inet {table} trace iifname "{self.bridge}" udp dport 53 meta nftrace set 1\n')
        trace=subprocess.Popen(['docker','exec',self.helper,'timeout','6','nft','--json','monitor','trace'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,creationflags=getattr(subprocess,'CREATE_NO_WINDOW',0))
        try:
            time.sleep(.2)
            answer=self.dns_probe(self.guest,'udp',self.gateway,53,'long.test')
            inspected=self.rpc('inspect',allow_uncertain=True)['result']
            self.evidence['focused_after_floor']={'reply':answer,'inspection':inspected}
        finally:
            out,err=trace.communicate(timeout=10)
            self.evidence['scoped_dns_trace']={'exit_code':trace.returncode,'stdout':out.decode(),'stderr':err.decode()};self.save()
        assert answer['ok'] and answer['rcode']==0,answer
        self.check('focused_dns_gateway_redirect_survives_destination_floor')
        self.collect_translation()

args=argparse.Namespace(image='goldenhoop-network-fixture:test',runtime='runc',output=sys.argv[1],remove_image=False,receiver_publication='loopback',ci_host_diagnostics=False,component_only=True,probe_only=True,resolver_path='owned',expect_unavailable=False,raw_control=False,dns_lifetime=120)
Diagnostic(args).run()
